summary: The filing is an 8-K reporting the results of Penske Automotive Group's 2026 annual meeting of stockholders (Item 5.07) and a press release announcing a quarterly dividend of $1.42 per share (Item 8.01). The meeting included the election of twelve director nominees, ratification of the independent auditor, and an advisory vote on executive compensation, all approved. No special situations—such as M&A, activist campaigns, or strategic reviews—are described. The dividend increase is a routine capital allocation decision, not a special-event category. Therefore, this filing does not qualify as a special situation.
